info.name: Banking System — Complete API Collection
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the Banking Microservices System.

Base URL: http://localhost:8080 (API Gateway)

## How to use
1. Run requests in the 'Auth' folder first — Login captures your access_token automatically
2. All other folders use {{access_token}} — set automatically by the Login request
3. Run the 'E2E — Full Flow' folder top-to-bottom for a complete test scenario

## Variables auto-captured by test scripts
- access_token — from Login response
- refresh_token — from Login response
- user_id — from Register or Create User
- user_id_2 — from Create User 2
- account_id — from Open Account 1
- account_id_2 — from Open Account 2
- txn_id — from any transaction
- notif_id — from Get Notifications
- audit_id — from Get Audit Events

item.name: Auth — No token required
item.description: All /v1/auth/** paths are public. No Authorization header needed.

request.description: Creates both credentials (in auth-service DB) and user profile (in user-service DB) in one call. Returns access + refresh tokens immediately.
Run this if your access token has expired (15 min TTL). Captures access_token and refresh_token automatically.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
Soft-revokes the refresh token in the DB. The access token still works until it expires (15 min). After logout, /refresh with this token returns 401.

item.name: Users
item.description: User profile management. All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.

request.description: Creates user profile only (no auth credentials). Usually called internally by auth-service /register. Use /auth/register for full user creation.
Soft delete — sets status=DELETED, returns 204. Row remains in DB.

item.name: Accounts
item.description: Bank account management. All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.

request.description: account-service calls user-service to verify userId is ACTIVE before creating. Publishes AccountAuditEvent to Kafka.
Returns 422 if insufficient funds.
Should return 422 Unprocessable Entity with InsufficientFundsException.
Soft close — sets status=CLOSED, returns 204.

item.name: Transactions
item.description: Money movement. All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.

request.description: Credits (adds money to) an account. No source account — money comes from outside.
Debits (removes money from) an account. No destination — money leaves the system.

Transfers money between accounts using the Saga pattern with compensation. Always returns 201 — check the 'status' field in the response. If the transfer fails, the debit is automatically reversed (compensation).
Intentional failure — destination account 99999 does not exist. Source account balance will NOT change (saga compensates by reversing the debit). Response status=FAILED.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Notifications are created asynchronously by RabbitMQ consumers (not via REST POST). Read-only from a client perspective. All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.

request.description: After running a transfer, wait 1-2 seconds then call this — should show a new UNREAD notification.

item.name: Audit
item.description: Immutable audit log. Read-only — no write endpoints. Records created exclusively by Kafka consumers. All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.

request.description: Shows complete change history for one account: CREATED, DEPOSITED, WITHDRAWN, STATUS_CHANGED, CLOSED events.
All audit events linked to this user across all account and transaction events.

item.name: E2E — Complete Flow (run in order)
item.description:
Run these requests top-to-bottom for a complete end-to-end test. Each request captures values into collection variables so the next request uses them automatically.

Scenario:
1. Register two users
2. Login as User 1
3. Open accounts for both users
4. Deposit to User 1's account
5. Transfer from User 1 to User 2
6. Check notifications (async — may need 1-2 sec)
7. Check audit trail (async — may need 1-2 sec)
8. Test saga compensation (intentional failure)
9. Verify balances unchanged after failed transfer

exec: console.log('[E2E 4] Account 1 opened. id =', body.id, '| balance =', body.balance);
console.log('[E2E 5] Account 2 opened. id =', body.id, '| balance =', body.balance);

item.name: E2E 6 — Transfer $750 from User 1 to User 2

exec: console.log('[E2E 6] Transfer status:', body.status, '| txn_id =', body.id);

item.name: E2E 9 — Check Notifications (wait 1-2 sec after transfer)

request.description: RabbitMQ consumer is async. If empty, wait 1-2 seconds and retry. Should contain UNREAD notification for the transfer.

exec: console.log('[E2E 9] No notifications yet — RabbitMQ may still be processing. Wait 1-2 sec and retry.');

item.name: E2E 10 — Check Audit Trail (wait 1-2 sec after transfer)

request.description: Kafka consumer is async. Should show the audit record for the transfer. Also check /v1/audit/entity/ACCOUNT/{{account_id}} for account-level events.

exec: console.log('[E2E 10] Audit events for transaction:', body.totalElements);
console.log('[E2E 10] First audit event:', body.content[0].action, '| occurredAt:', body.content[0].occurredAt);
console.log('[E2E 10] No audit events yet — Kafka consumer may still be processing. Wait 1-2 sec and retry.');

item.name: E2E 11 — Saga Compensation: Transfer to invalid account

request.description: Destination account 99999 does not exist. transfer-service will: (1) debit Account 1, (2) fail to credit 99999, (3) automatically re-deposit to Account 1 (compensation). Net result: Account 1 balance unchanged.

exec: console.log('[E2E 11] Account 1 balance should be UNCHANGED — saga compensation ran');

item.name: E2E 12 — Verify Account 1 Unchanged After Failed Transfer

exec: pm.test('Balance unchanged after failed transfer (saga worked)', function() {
console.log('[E2E 12] Account 1 balance after failed transfer:', body.balance);
console.log('[E2E 12] Expected: still $1250 (saga compensation restored the debit)');
